name: BurnsDefi
fix_description: In burnToHolder, the ETH payout (deserved) is calculated using uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut which reads instant AMM reserves. An attacker can flash-loan manipulate the pair price before calling burnToHolder to extract disproportionate ETH. Use a TWAP oracle or fixed exchange rate instead of spot price.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a flash-loan-driven price manipulation against protocol-specific reward logic: it requires understanding how burnToHolder derives value from the Burns/WBNB pool and coordinating several swaps across multiple pairs before claiming rewards. While the attack flow is not extremely long, it involves multi-contract DeFi interactions and nontrivial reserve/math reasoning, putting it above a simple obvious bug.
